detect: (?m)^(?:GREEN = enabled by default|YELLOW = disabled by default|RED = unimplemented|\s*-W[\w+#=-]+\s*$)
parser:
import re

def parse(lines):
    legend = []
    legend_lines = []
    rows = []
    row_lines = []
    skip = []
    stack = []
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^(?P<color>GREEN|YELLOW|RED)\s*=\s*(?P<meaning>\S.*?)\s*$', ln)
        if m:
            legend.append({'color': m.group('color'), 'meaning': m.group('meaning')})
            legend_lines.append(i)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^(?P<indent>\s*)(?P<flag>-W\S+)\s*$', ln)
        if m:
            depth = len(m.group('indent').expandtabs(8)) // 2
            del stack[depth:]
            parent = stack[-1] if stack else ''
            stack.append(m.group('flag'))
            rows.append({'flag': m.group('flag'), 'depth': depth, 'parent': parent})
            row_lines.append(i)
            continue
        skip.append(i)
    blocks = []
    if legend:
        blocks.append({'name': 'legend', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': legend_lines, 'records': legend})
    if rows:
        blocks.append({'name': 'warning_groups', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': row_lines, 'records': rows})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}

GREEN = enabled by default
YELLOW = disabled by default
